response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with a strong web/backend background, but the profile does not align with this embedded LAN-switch security role. There is no native-level Japanese (a hard requirement), no demonstrated Linux kernel analysis or source modification, and no experience with MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, chip-vendor SDKs, or L2/L3 switch firmware. C experience is limited to a short stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, with recent work centered on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. The general seniority and breadth are genuine positives, but the gap against the core requirements is too large to justify an interview.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across many domains
Some C/C++ background (National Instruments, C++ audio/Linux projects)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools, open-source authorship
concerns: No evidence of Japanese language ability (native-level required)
No embedded networking, switch, or security-protocol (MACsec/802.1X) experience
No Linux kernel investigation or source-code modification experience

key_factors.factor: Missing embedded networking and security domain expertise
Dated and limited C / systems programming depth
